xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5461: Computer use: Settings page with one-click setup (Linux)

plan.title: Computer use: Settings page with one-click setup (Linux)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Operator approved this scope as one issue (mockup 2026-11-17); Windows and macOS are already split into PAN-5462/PAN-5463. The seam, routes and Settings page are one feature: a seam with no page, or a page with no setup, gives the operator nothing. Most of the ~40 files are new small modules and their tests (PRD D-13).

narratives.Problem: Turning on computer use (PAN-5452) means hand-editing ~/.overdeck/config.yaml, and its readiness checks exist only inside pan doctor, which prints nothing while the feature is off. There is also no seam for the Windows (PAN-5462) and macOS (PAN-5463) providers, so they would have to edit Linux-only branches.
narratives.Proposal: Add a platform provider seam (src/lib/computer-use/platform.ts) with one Linux provider; move the readiness probes into the library (doctor wraps them with its legacy rows); add Linux setup steps (pkexec install with a terminal fallback, gsettings accessibility); add a settings door, a status view and a setup orchestrator; expose four admin-only routes; and add Settings -> Computer Use with one primary button, a command-palette entry, and docs. Full detail in the PRD work items WI-1a..WI-8.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Windows/WSL2 and macOS providers (PAN-5462, PAN-5463); WSL2 is detected and refused here
- Uninstalling packages or turning GNOME accessibility off when the feature is turned off
- Running apt-get update or any package-index refresh
- Taking package names, commands or paths from any request body
- route-scopes.ts rows or any scoped-token access to the new routes
- Per-project computer-use settings; the flag stays global-layer-only
- A dashboard feed of agent desktop actions or screenshots
- Individual per-check fix buttons (one primary button only)
- Changing pan doctor output content or pan computer capabilities output shape
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt cap

autoDecisions.summary: Ship as one issue with plan.metadata.sizeJustification instead of splitting into more sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator approved this scope as one issue; platform siblings already exist; the remaining slices are not useful to the operator on their own (PRD D-13).

autoDecisions.summary: pan doctor keeps its exact rows through a fixed legacy message table, runs the handshake without the desktop lock, and skips setup-step planning.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-11 requires unchanged doctor content and the existing doctor test must pass unedited; taking the lock in doctor would be a behavior change nobody asked for (PRD D-14).

autoDecisions.summary: Detect the Linux package manager locally with which through the injected execFile; never import src/lib/prereqs/registry.ts.
autoDecisions.rationale: registry.ts pulls chalk, Semgrep install and terminal-backend code into the computer-use lib and its checkCommand spawns real processes tests cannot inject (PAN-5461 D-15).

autoDecisions.summary: assertKeyComboAllowed fails closed (unsupported_platform) for windows/mac until their rule tables exist.
autoDecisions.rationale: A fail-open default on a safety check is the wrong failure mode even when unreachable (PRD D-16).

autoDecisions.summary: Ship both the pkexec install path and the terminal-window fallback; the live checkpoint only records which one this desktop takes.
autoDecisions.rationale: Whether polkit finds an agent for a systemd user service varies by desktop; both paths are needed for real operators and can be unit-tested without a desktop (PRD D-17).

autoDecisions.summary: Use the MousePointerClick icon instead of MonitorCog.
autoDecisions.rationale: MonitorCog does not exist in the installed lucide-react@0.400.0 (PRD D-18).

autoDecisions.summary: Entry points are the Settings nav item, the command palette, and the disabled error text; no conversation-tab or Home entry.
autoDecisions.rationale: This is a one-time host setting; operators meet it through an agent's disabled error, which now names the page (PRD D-19).

metadata.readinessReason: Touches only the new setup-linux.ts and its test.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4a. Create src/lib/computer-use/setup-linux.ts (types from platform-types.ts) with installCommandText (all five managers), installPackages(pm, packages, session, deps) for apt-get/dnf/pacman, manualInstallResult(pm, packages) for zypper/apk/null (failed with the command, or the package names when no manager, D-4) and enableGnomeAccessibility(session, deps). installPackages resolves the manager path with which, runs execFile('pkexec', [pmPath, ...args, ...packages], { env: session.env, timeout: 600000 }), maps exit 126 to the cancelled message, exit 127 / 'No authentication agent found' / ENOENT to the terminal fallback (gnome-terminal, x-terminal-emulator, konsole, xterm via an injected spawnDetached that defaults to spawn(...).unref()), and other errors to failed with the apt 'Unable to locate package' hint. Every failed result carries the copyable sudo command. Packages only come from LINUX_PACKAGES (D-3). Tests inject execFile and spawnDetached; never vi.mock child_process; never run apt-get update.

items.title: Given apt-get and ['xdotool'], installPackages calls execFile with 'pkexec' and ['/usr/bin/apt-get','install','-y','xdotool'] and session.env, and returns status 'done' on success
When pkexec exits 126, installPackages returns failed with the 'password prompt was cancelled' message and command 'sudo apt-get install -y xdotool'

When pkexec exits 127 or is missing (ENOENT), installPackages spawns gnome-terminal with ['--','bash','-c',<script>] and returns failed with the 'terminal window opened' message; with no terminal found it returns the 'Run this command' message
enableGnomeAccessibility runs gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface toolkit-accessibility true with session.env and returns done, or failed with the gsettings command on error
manualInstallResult('zypper', ['xdotool']) returns failed with command 'sudo zypper install -y xdotool', and manualInstallResult(null, ...) returns failed with no command
